$comment: Simp Machine symbol art. Keys are symbol ids from src/games/slot/config.ts (never rename them). To swap art: drop a square image (svg, png or webp, transparent background, 512x512 or larger) in this folder and point src at it. label is the on-screen name, alt is for screen readers, credit is shown in the game's art credits. founder-1/2/3 are the face symbols (ids are fixed): founder-1 is swapped at runtime for the signed-in simp's NFT, src here is the signed-out fallback. Missing entries fall back to <id>.svg (the original placeholder drawings, still in this folder). Full sources and licence notes: research/monad-assets/SOURCES.md.
